title: MiniMax-H3 Text to Video + Audio (TPU)
description: Turns a sentence into a 5-second video (124 frames at 24 fps, 672x384) with matching stereo sound, using MiniMax-H3 (2-bit GGUF) and Comfy-Org's 8-step turbo LoRA, in JAX on a Colab TPU. Needs a TPU v5e-1 runtime: it does not run on CPU or GPU. First run on a fresh TPU: about 4 minutes of setup (installs JAX for TPU, downloads about 28 GB of weights; the two GGUFs go into RAM) before generating. Each clip then takes about 3 minutes 15 seconds: about 95 s to load the models from RAM, 77 s for the 8 denoising steps, and 40 s to decode video and audio. Weights: MiniMax H3 Community License (commercial use only outside the EU, UK, South Korea and US, and with permission above $20M yearly revenue).
author: NZAP Labs

params.label: Prompt
params.default: a golden retriever puppy running through a sunny meadow of wildflowers toward the camera, happy barking, birds singing
params.description: Describe the scene, the motion and the sound. One clear subject works best.

params.label: Turbo steps
params.description: 8 steps is the tested setting. 4 steps uses the 768p-trained 4-step LoRA and is about 20 s faster.
